card.name: Comma after "often, but not always"
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma right after "often, but not always" in the NSAID oligohydramnios warning, before "reversible". Also once on "was" after "The angioedema".

modes.label: Comma in hedged phrase
modes.description: Comma closing the hedge "often, but not always" just before a describing adjective.
modes.example: Oligohydramnios is often, but not always<<,>> reversible with treatment discontinuation.

modes.label: Verb after angioedema
modes.description: The word "was" after the subject "The angioedema", before a passive verb like diagnosed.
modes.example: The angioedema<< was>> diagnosed by procedures including

card.writes: Little clear effect; it slightly favors words like "uniformly" and disfavors "already" and "vulnerable".
card.plain: It fires on one repeated warning sentence about oligohydramnios being often, but not always, reversible.
